summary: Telefônica Brasil filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of a BRL 230M interest on capital (IoC) distribution, equivalent to R$0.072 per share gross (R$0.059 net after 17.5% withholding tax). The record date is June 26, 2026; shares trade ex-IoC thereafter. The net amount will count toward the mandatory minimum dividend for FY2026, payable by April 30, 2027. This is a routine capital return through Brazil's IoC mechanism, not a special event like a tender or buyback. The filing is a conventional distribution announcement with no strategic premium or structural complexity. What to watch: any change in share count due to an active buyback program.
